limits: Three confirmation seeds provide descriptive replication; no conventional 5% significance claim.
A missing feasible functional reference leaves relevant directional decisions unevaluable.
Artificial input-path improvements are not automatically learned memory.
Reference support alone is not necessity; only recorded ablations test necessity at that configuration.
Null decisions mean missing/invalid matched controls, not negative findings. New cues share a fixed probe sequence with rest, not hard state resets.
G is a fixed 64-fold diagnostic intervention, not a test of every possible strength. Pair ignores the chemical learning factor.
Total mechanism interaction includes cellular and synaptic effects. Deterministic per-seed contrast is not a population significance test.
